csv_project_name: As-Needed Energy Efficiency Project Services EEPMA
csv_agency: Los Angeles Co ISD Purchasing Division
csv_scope_of_work: The County of Los Angeles (County), Internal Services (ISD) Department is seeking qualified companies to enter into an Energy Efficiency Project Services Master Agreement (EEPMA) with the County to provide energy efficiency project services on an as-needed basis. The purpose of this Request for Statement of Qualifications (RFSQ) is to ensure the continuous provision of energy efficiency project services which are currently being provided by qualified vendors through EEPMA. EEPMA has provided a timely, efficient, and cost-effective method of enabling ISD to respond to various energy issues.
